raw_text:
ANANYA KRISHNAMURTHY
+91 93427 81056 | ananya.krishnamurthy@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/ananyakrishnamurthy | github.com/ananya-kris | Bengaluru, Karnataka
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Final-year B.Sc Statistics & Data Science student at CHRIST University with a strong foundation in statistical modelling, machine learning, and business intelligence. Experienced in the full data pipeline — from wrangling messy real-world datasets to communicating findings through dashboards and reports. Completed a data analytics internship delivering revenue insights for an e-commerce client. Seeking a Data Scientist Internship to apply rigorous quantitative thinking to product and business problems.
EDUCATION
B.Sc (Honours) — Statistics & Data Science 2022 – 2025 (Expected)
CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru CGPA: 9.3 / 10.0
Relevant Coursework: Regression Analysis, Multivariate Statistics, Time Series, Bayesian Inference, Data Mining, R Programming, Stochastic Processes
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Python, R, SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
ML & Statistics: Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, XGBoost, LightGBM, SciPy, Pingouin
Data & Visualisation: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Tableau, Power BI
Tools & Platforms: Git, Jupyter, Google Colab, BigQuery (basic), Excel (advanced), Streamlit
EXPERIENCE
Data Analytics Intern — Meesho (E-commerce), Bengaluru May 2024 – Jul 2024
Analysed 2.1 million transaction records across 14 product categories using SQL and Python to identify seasonal demand patterns, surfacing insights adopted into the Q3 inventory replenishment model.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard tracking seller return rates and customer lifetime value (CLTV) by geography; used weekly by the business analytics team of 12.
Conducted A/B test analysis on two promotional banner variants using a two-proportion z-test (n = 84,000), finding a statistically significant 3.2% lift in click-through rate (p < 0.01).
PROJECTS
Customer Churn Prediction | Python, XGBoost, SHAP, Streamlit Jan 2025 – Mar 2025
Built an end-to-end churn prediction pipeline on a 71,000-customer telecom dataset; XGBoost with SMOTE oversampling achieved AUC-ROC of 0.923 and recall of 88.4% on the minority class.
Applied SHAP TreeExplainer to generate feature-level explanations, identifying contract type and tenure as the two strongest churn predictors — consistent with domain expectations.
Deployed model as a Streamlit app with single-customer and batch-scoring modes; average prediction latency under 200 ms per record.
Urban Air Quality Forecasting | Python, Prophet, Statsmodels, Plotly Aug 2024 – Oct 2024
Collected 3 years of hourly PM2.5 and AQI data from the CPCB open data portal for 6 Bengaluru monitoring stations and built station-level time series forecasting models using Facebook Prophet.
Tuned seasonality components and holiday regressors to achieve a MAPE of 8.7% on a 60-day held-out window, outperforming a SARIMA baseline by 2.4 percentage points.
Presented analysis at the university's Annual Statistics Symposium 2024; awarded Best Student Paper among 31 submissions.
IPL Batting Performance Analytics | R, ggplot2, dplyr, Shiny Mar 2024 – Apr 2024
Scraped and cleaned ball-by-ball data for IPL seasons 2018–2023 (480,000+ deliveries) using rvest and tidyr; modelled batter consistency using coefficient of variation and Bayesian shrinkage estimates.
Built an R Shiny dashboard enabling head-to-head batter comparisons across venues, opposition, and match phases; shared publicly, receiving 1,100+ sessions in the first two weeks.
CERTIFICATIONS
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate — Coursera (8 courses) Completed: Oct 2023
Statistical Learning — Stanford Online (Trevor Hastie & Robert Tibshirani) Completed: Apr 2024
ACHIEVEMENTS
National finalist, Unstop Data Science Challenge 2024 — ranked 11th out of 3,800+ participants in a two-stage predictive modelling competition on healthcare insurance data.
Kaggle Expert (Notebooks tier) — 3 notebooks awarded Gold status, including an EDA of the WHO Global Health Observatory dataset with 4,300+ views.
University Rank 1 in Statistics & Data Science cohort (2022–23); awarded the Vice-Chancellor's Merit Prize for academic excellence.
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Founder & Lead, Data Science Society, CHRIST — built the club from 12 to 90 members in 18 months; organised monthly hands-on workshops covering SQL, Tableau, and predictive modelling (2023–Present).
Open Source: contributed 2 merged PRs to the Pandas documentation, clarifying GroupBy aggregation examples flagged as confusing by new users.
Mentored 8 second-year students through the university's peer-mentoring programme on Python for data analysis; 6 of 8 completed their first Kaggle submission within the programme.
